[/s]A seasonal medieval tiny greenhouse that can be purchased from Robin as a standalone building after the player reaches [b][color=#d9ead3]Farming lvl 4[/color][/b].

The greenhouse has more accurate ambience lighting compared to vanilla buildings and will become slightly dark inside when it is raining outside, and very dark inside when it is night time unless there are light sources placed inside. 🌧🌙🔆

Originally a retexture of Inmognito's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12459]Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations[/url] mod. ♡

The mod will detect what recolour you have installed and apply it automatically for both the exterior and interior.
You can also manually change the recolour options in the config options if you wish.

If you use the [b]Light[/b] theme option with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url], you will need to [i]manually[/i] change the Glass Frame color and the Flooring color to [b]Light[/b].

You can change the interior and exterior options using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or opening and editing the config.json file that generates in the mod
folder after first launch of the game when the mod is installed.
If you decide to change your options through the config.json, please see the Readme file included in the mod folder or this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1996]Article[/url]﻿﻿﻿ for config option names.
